tooltips.supertextConnection: The Supertext connection with the API key. Empty: the first connection of type Supertext, or the SUPERTEXT_API_KEY environment variable.
tooltips.supertextSourceLanguage: The language to translate from. Empty: the main language.
tooltips.supertextTargetLanguages: The languages to translate into. Empty: every other language.
tooltips.supertextOverwrite: Off: fields that already have text in a target language are kept. On: they are replaced by the new translation.
tooltips.supertextPoliteness: Formal or informal form of address, for languages that have both (e.g. Sie/du in German).

messages.supertextKeyHelp: No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin. Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API; requires the Admin role).
messages.supertextNoApiKey: No Supertext API key is configured.
messages.supertextNoApiKeyConnection: No Supertext API key is configured. Create a connection of type "Supertext" under Administration → Connections.
messages.supertextConnectionNotFound: The Supertext connection {id} was not found.
messages.supertextNeedsRecord: Translate with Supertext runs on a record: use it from a record or from the list (mass action).
messages.supertextNoTextFields: {entity} has no multilingual text fields. Make the fields multilingual and add languages under Administration → Languages.
messages.supertextNotALanguage: "{language}" is not one of the languages of this record ({languages}).
messages.supertextUnreachable: The Supertext service could not be reached.
messages.supertextAuthFailed: Authentication failed. Please check the Supertext API key.
messages.supertextNotFound: The requested Supertext resource was not found.
messages.supertextTooLarge: The content is too large for Supertext to translate in one go.
messages.supertextRateLimited: Too many requests to Supertext. Please try again shortly.
messages.supertextUnavailable: The Supertext service is currently unavailable.
messages.supertextNoFileId: Supertext did not return a file id.
messages.supertextFailed: Supertext could not translate the document.
messages.supertextLimitExceeded: Your Supertext translation limit is exceeded. Please upgrade your subscription.
messages.supertextDeleted: The document was deleted at Supertext before it could be downloaded.
messages.supertextTimeout: Timed out waiting for the Supertext translation.
messages.supertextTooLong: The translation is longer than the field allows: {fields}.
messages.supertextPartlyTooLong: Not translated because the translation is too long: {fields}.
messages.supertextRejected: AtroPIM did not accept the translation: {reason}
messages.supertextNoTargets: No other languages to translate into.
messages.supertextRecordsFailed: The Executions panel of the action shows why.
